title: Driver Qualification and Insurance Terms, Courtesy Transportation Agreements
content:
Terms on drivers and insurance printed for each program of the Courtesy Transportation Agreements.

| Program | Least age of the driver | Own auto insurance must be shown and is primary | Damage waiver can be bought | Second named driver may be added | Least age of an additional driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 21 | Yes | No | No | 0 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 21 | Yes | No | Yes | 21 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 21 | Yes | No | Yes | 21 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 25 | Yes | No | Yes | 25 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 21 | Yes | No | Yes | 21 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 21 | Yes | No | Yes | 21 |

## Terms explained

- **Least age of the driver**: the minimum age, in years, of the driver of the loaner.
- **Own auto insurance**: a switch stating whether the customer's own auto insurance must be shown and is primary for the loaner. It reads Yes for every program.
- **Damage waiver**: a switch stating whether a damage waiver can be bought. It reads No for every program, so no program offers one.
- **Second named driver**: a switch stating whether a second named driver may be added to the agreement.
- **Least age of an additional driver**: the minimum age, in years, of an additional driver. The Same-Day Courtesy Loaner shows 0 because that program adds no second driver at all.

## Points of judgement

- The Courtesy Loaner - SUV is the only program with a minimum age of 25, both for the driver and for any additional driver; every other program uses 21 where a second driver is allowed.
- Under the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner, the agreement has one driver only.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Hypothetical driver | Program | Program minimum | Meets the age term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aged 24 | Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 25 | No |
| Aged 25 | Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 25 | Yes |
| Aged 21 | Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 21 | Yes |
| Aged 20 | Warranty Rental Loaner | 21 | No |

The ages in the first column are invented for illustration.
